package members_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	pb "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/grpc/members/pb"
	members "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/members"
)

func TestMounted(t *testing.T) {
	e := &members.Endpoints{
		UnimplementedMembersServer: func(_ context.Context, req any) (any, error) {
			return "UnimplementedMembersServer:" + req.(string), nil

		},
	}
	ctx, client := mountedClient(t, e)
	input := "input"
	r0, err0 := client.UnimplementedMembersServer(ctx, &pb.UnimplementedMembersServerRequest{Field: &input})
	require.NoError(t, err0)
	require.Equal(t, "UnimplementedMembersServer:input", r0.GetField())
}
